data.content_ref: inline:Self-contradiction on necessity: the claim makes author-mutation-firing the condition under which a test constrains rather than describes, but its own counterconditions correctly state (a) that shown-to-fail-first installation with a non-reflexive guard still losing mutations shows the condition is not necessary, and (b) that other modules' guards catching author mutations at 4/4 to 6/7 shows it is not sufficient. A condition that is simultaneously not necessary and not sufficient given the problem's own data is not a condition at all — the claim and its counterconditions cancel, leaving the question unanswered.
